heading: Today
text: A few patches of fog, then periods of sunshine.  A few showers developing in NY late morning, becoming likely with a possible thunderstorm this afternoon, spreading into VT and Berkshires later in the day.  Warm and humid.  Highs ranging through the 80s.  Light winds, tending to becoming south to southwest near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Scattered evening showers or thunderstorms, diminishing overnight.  Periods of clouds, and some patches of fog.  Warm and very muggy.  Lows in the 60s, closer to 70 in the Champlain Valley.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: A mix of sun and clouds.  A chance of a few widely scattered showers or a thunderstorm, mainly in the afternoon and evening.  Continued quite warm and humid.  Highs in the 80s to near 90.  Light winds, tending to become west less than 10 mph.
